title: The Known World
excerpt: A dark world that lights up as travellers wrote it down. From 681 journeys: Europe's recorded world covered 20% of the land in 1492 and 67% in 1900, and much of the dark had been recorded by China, the Islamic world or Polynesian voyagers first.
seo_description: How much of the Earth Europe, the Islamic world, China and Polynesia had recorded, 2200 BC to 1960, mapped from 681 journeys.
header_alt: Title card reading 'The Known World' in black and red on pale paper, beside four strips of a black world map lit in cream and blue for 1000, 1550, 1800 and 1960. Text: Europe's recorded world in 1492, 20% of the land; 1800, 44%; 1900, 67%.
